Strategy: Scale both the sweet-band reward and the mid penalty down to twelve, testing whether even gentler steering still beats Best Fit. This keeps almost all Best Fit behavior intact, but the smaller adjustments may rarely change any ranking.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (12 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (12 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
